items.content_html: Mini-Colab is a lightweight, container-backed web IDE. Each user runs in an isolated Docker container with a session-scoped workspace, Monaco editor, terminal, file explorer, and an admin dashboard for quotas and session control. Built with React (TypeScript) and FastAPI, it supports local images and custom Docker builds out of the box.
